method: Edit Mode only: load the saved prefab into a temporary PrefabContents scene; if present, initialize its production refined geometry binding through RefinedHelmetBinding.RefreshVisualBinding before configuring the existing guide; call SetSectionPlane(normal, 0), then invoke its actual private UpdateGuidePose by reflection. Never save prefab contents.
limitations: Explicit geometry/API regression, not simulated XR selection, physical dragging, hardware, rendered pixels, usability, or a player build. Root scales remain the prefab's unit scale. A baseline failure is reported as failed, never converted into an expected pass.
thresholds: Normal n(theta)=(cos(theta),sin(theta),0). Rotation <= max(0.08 degrees, 3*normal delta+0.02 degrees); knob displacement <= 3*(2*radius*sin(normal delta/2))+0.00005 m; center/plane error <=0.0001 m; forward error <=0.08 degrees; root position/scale drift <=0.000001; root rotation drift <=0.0001 degrees. These are numerical continuity checks, not comfort thresholds.
